# civica Design System

> Independent Home Assistant interface system adapted from UK public service design. Use civica identity for project documentation and promotion; household identity is optional and user chosen; do not use official government marks or GDS Transport. This file is a reading index, not a source of authority over the user's instructions.

## Start here

- [Design contract](design-contract.json): machine-readable rules, scope, source hierarchy and verification boundaries.
- [Get started](get-started/index.html): layers and principles.
- [About this project](get-started/about.html): the author's purpose, independent identity, original explanatory illustrations and accessibility aims.
- [Compatibility](get-started/compatibility.html): native/third-party coverage and limits.
- [Architecture](community/architecture.html): real Middleman Tech Docs Template; GOV.UK Design System information architecture.

## Canonical implementation sources in the repository

- design-system/palettes.json: ten exact supplied palettes and Vivid/Muted tone metadata.
- design-system/themes.json: generated resolved HA variables with separate light/dark modes.
- design-system/upstream-sources.json: immutable Home Assistant frontend sources inspected.
- themes/civica.yaml: the default civica theme and twenty named palette variants.
- themes/govuk.yaml: compatibility alias, independent civica identity.
- ui/src/civica-ui.ts and ui/src/theme-settings.ts: optional companion sources; build output is ui/dist/civica-ui.js.
- ui/src/action-links.ts: real local navigation links, included in the companion module.
- ui/src/legacy-card-styles.ts: scoped presentation adapters for three known household cards.
- ui/src/sidebar-badges.ts: numeric sidebar attention counts; no notification or device commands.
- brand/civica/: unchanged accepted artwork from civica_brand_assets_revised.zip and provenance records.

## Design rules

- [Personalise your home](get-started/personalisation.html): family or business name, optional crest/logo, native dashboard options and proposed shell behaviour.
- [Project identity](styles/brand.html): Revised civica artwork for project documentation and promotion, with preserved geometry and provenance.
- [Artwork manifest](reference/brand-assets.json): byte-identical documentation copies mapped to the supplied archive.
- [Colour](styles/colour.html): exact palette pairs and semantic roles.
- [Palette JSON](reference/palettes.json): published copy of canonical palette data.
- [Typography](styles/typography.html): Arial, readable hierarchy and wrapping.
- [Layout](styles/layout.html): native responsive grids and consistent spacing.
- [Images](styles/images.html): purposeful icons and images with labels.
- [Notification badge](components/notification-badge.html): exact MOJ rounded red geometry, count limits and HA live-update adaptation.
- [Writing guide](content/index.html): a main section for plain UK English, precise state/action wording and dated Home Assistant terminology. Existing /content/ links and rule anchors are preserved; /styles/content.html is a legacy entry point.

## Components and patterns

- [Components](components/index.html): navigation, controls, devices, cards, status, dialogs and charts.
- [ONS-based Energy charts](components/charts.html): implemented native chart adapter, geometry, data alternatives, supported hosts and limits from v1.3.0, including opaque fills and explicit chart types.
- [Working chart examples](components/chart-examples.html): real-renderer demonstrations with invented values; not live household evidence.
- [ONS chart source snapshot](reference/ons-chart-sources.json): versioned source evidence and deliberate local adaptations.
- [Action links](components/action-links.html): manual card configuration, native navigation and existing fragment pop-ups.
- [Patterns](patterns/index.html): home/rooms, native Energy, settings and recovery.
- [Colour settings](get-started/colour-settings.html): native preference flow and standalone-card fallback.
- [Deviations](community/deviations.html): explicit local adaptations and their limits.

## Public theme roadmap

- [Theme roadmap](community/roadmap.html): reviewed theme features only, with separate agreed-but-not-started Accepted work, work in progress and delivered features grouped by UTC closure month. Documentation changes are excluded.
- [Public roadmap data](reference/roadmap.json): schema2 allowlisted categories, title and household benefit; no issue identities, developer notes or raw payloads.
- [Maintain the roadmap](community/maintain-roadmap.html): standard GitHub issue form, maintainer publishing labels, writing review, status semantics and build checks.

## Evidence

- [Testing](accessibility/testing.html): automation, manual checks and live HA verification.
- [Sources](community/sources.html): official guidance reviewed 11 November 2026.
- [Visual review](community/visual-audit.html): baseline deficiencies in border hierarchy, generic radius overrides and icon scope.
- [Visual audit source snapshot](reference/visual-audit-sources.json): immutable official code references and SHA-256 hashes.
- [Licensing](community/licensing.html): attribution and supplied asset status.

Do not equate a local build, screenshot or token test with live Home Assistant deployment. Do not claim full WCAG compliance from colour tests. Preserve native Energy, Map, device semantics, permissions and translations. Do not modify live household configuration merely to preview this documentation.

- [Chart colour](styles/chart-colour.html): deterministic identity colours, Vivid/Muted and Light/Dark variants, patterns and limits.
- [Chart colour contract](reference/chart-colours.json): machine-readable generation rules and identity policy.

## Expanded documentation catalogue

- [Coverage and boundaries](community/coverage.html): complete reviewed GOV.UK37/NHS38/NHS13/Publishing42 source mapping, with overlap and scope explained.
- [Machine-readable coverage](reference/coverage.json): source inventories, every guidance route and standalone example ID.
- [Example viewer](components/example.html): one source for isolated preview, standalone page and copied HTML; safe local demonstration contract.
- [Page metadata and history](components/page-history.html): real publication/update records and current publishing-library terminology.
- [BSL](patterns/british-sign-language.html): discovery, production, review and explicit unavailable states.
- [Question pages and dialogs](patterns/question-pages.html): bounded modal adaptation and accessible task flow.
- [Publishing guidance](publishing/index.html): editorial components, patterns and recursively mapped page templates.

Reference catalogue coverage does not mean those components have replaced native Home Assistant. Read each page’s implementation boundary. Example canvases use synthetic data and do not issue household commands.

## Design styles, writing and whole-system audit

- [Colour roles](styles/brand-colour.html), [typography principles](styles/brand-typography.html), [data communication](styles/brand-data.html), [illustration](styles/illustration.html): selected GOV.UK Brand guidance adapted to civica; local rule IDs and explicit exclusions.
- [Writing guide](content/index.html): bespoke household content rules, with examples and source decisions.
- [Design-style rules and source evidence](reference/brand-guidance.json), [writing rules and evidence](reference/writing-guide.json): machine-readable rules and source coverage.
- [Work-package checklist](community/guidance-work-package.html): original review and follow-up remediation phases, evidence and repeatable checks.
- [Whole-system audit](community/design-system-audit.html) and [audit data](reference/design-system-audit.json): evidence, affected rules, priorities and acceptance criteria.
- [Component organisation](community/component-audit.html) and [Home Assistant specification coverage](community/missing-components.html): shared owners, 38 dedicated native-task specifications, stable URLs and implementation boundaries.

Apply MUST rules to their stated scope. SHOULD rules allow an evidenced exception. Do not treat audit proposals as implemented features or infer live Home Assistant verification from documentation checks.

- [Native controls and flows](home-assistant/index.html): state/capability contracts, complete synthetic examples and integration acceptance for the 38 documented task families.
- [Compatibility register](home-assistant/compatibility-register.html): exact maintained adapters and native fallback.

## Versioned Home Assistant coverage and terminology

- [Coverage audit](community/home-assistant-coverage-audit.html): current source scope, checklists and verification boundaries.
- [Interface census](home-assistant/interface-coverage.html) and [machine register](reference/ha-interface-coverage.json): exact source entries mapped to components, styles and patterns; pinned Core/frontend versions and exclusions.
- [Terminology](content/home-assistant-terminology.html) and [machine register](reference/ha-terminology.json): official glossary, native domains, named vocabulary inventories and context-dependent labels. Preserve native translations and distinguish code values from translation keys.
- [UK systems review](community/uk-design-system-review.html) and [crosswalk](reference/uk-design-system-crosswalk.json): current catalogues, detail-review constraints and source-to-family decisions.
- [Sliders](components/sliders.html): local civica range anatomy, precise alternatives, explicit provenance and failure states.
- [Coverage verification](reference/ha-coverage-verification.json): independently reviewed scope, executed checks and publication status. A registry mapping is not live native implementation evidence.

- [Project story and navigation review](reference/project-story-review.json): copy, illustration provenance and verification for the About page and separate Writing guide section.
